title: Import your Xaman account with secret numbers
description: Step by step XRP Mobile tutorial: import an existing XRP Ledger account using the 8 rows of secret numbers that Xaman gives you as a backup. Type the rows in order, watch each one validate its own checksum, set a device PIN, and the account comes back with the same address and balance. Never share your secret numbers with anyone.
lede: If your XRP account came from Xaman, your backup is not twelve words. It's eight rows of numbers, and XRP Mobile takes them exactly as they are.

steps.caption: Open XRP Mobile, tap Import wallet
steps.body: Open XRP Mobile and choose Import wallet. Nothing is created here: you are bringing back an account that already exists on the ledger.

shots.alt: Open XRP Mobile, tap Import wallet

steps.caption: Choose secret numbers
steps.body: Pick secret numbers rather than recovery phrase. Same account either way, just the format your backup happens to be in.

steps.caption: Eight rows of six digits
steps.body: Type the rows in order, A through H. Six digits each, forty eight in total, and the keypad moves to the next row on its own.

steps.caption: Each row checks itself
steps.body: A green tick means that row's checksum adds up. If one refuses to go green, you have a digit wrong in that row and nowhere else, which is the whole point of the format.

steps.caption: Name it and set a PIN
steps.body: Then a name and a PIN for this phone. The PIN is local: it guards the app on this device, it is not part of your account.

shots.alt: Name it and set a PIN

steps.caption: Same account, back
steps.body: And your account is restored. Same address, same balance, and your secret numbers never left the phone.
